user.title: Activate MAIKA Speaker
user.description: Installation code: {activation_code}. Enter the activation server URL supplied by the seller and your license key. Easy Mode automatically binds the first Home Assistant that uses the key. Only a hash derived from the Home Assistant instance ID is sent; MAIKA credentials are never sent to the activation server.

activation_pending.title: Waiting for approval
activation_pending.description: This server is using manual approval. Installation code: {activation_code}. Send this code to the seller, then select Submit after approval.

account.title: Connect a MAIKA account
account.description: Enter a phone number or an email/Gmail address registered with MAIKA. Email login requires the MAIKA account password; Google Sign-In without a MAIKA password is not supported. Credentials are sent only to the MAIKA cloud, never to the activation server.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect MAIKA
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current MAIKA account credentials.

license.title: License and activation
license.description: Installation code: {activation_code}. Current status: {license_status}. Leave the license key blank to refresh the existing activation, or enter a new key to replace it.

license_pending.title: Waiting for approval
license_pending.description: This server is using manual approval. Installation code: {activation_code}. Send this code to the seller, then select Submit after approval.

features.title: MAIKA options
features.description: Experimental features are off by default. Enabling the voice command sensor stores recognized phrases in Home Assistant state and may record them in history. Rules use exact accent-insensitive matching and can only turn on, turn off or toggle one entity. Enter an optional HTTP(S) MP3 URL to play it only after a matched Home Assistant action completes successfully. Leave the URL blank to disable feedback. If this entry has one MAIKA speaker it is selected automatically; unmatched or failed commands never send playback commands.

data.enable_voice_command_sensor: Enable latest voice command sensor and rules
data.voice_command_rules: Rules, one per line: phrase | entity_id | turn_on/turn_off/toggle
